beats.event: Dr Mortimer brings Holmes the Baskerville family legend
Reveals Sir Charles found dead with hound's paw prints nearby
Sir Henry arrives; boot stolen, warned by anonymous letter
Holmes sends Watson as bodyguard to Dartmoor
News that convict Selden has escaped onto the moor
Party reaches Baskerville Hall; meets the Barrymores
Watson catches Barrymore signalling by candle to the moor
Discovers Selden is Mrs Barrymore's fugitive brother
Watson spots a mysterious stranger watching from a tor
Sir Henry falls for Beryl Stapleton; Jack objects fiercely
Watson finds the stranger is Holmes, working in secret
Holmes identifies Stapleton as the killer behind the hound
Selden killed by hound, mistaken for Sir Henry in his clothes
Holmes sends Sir Henry alone across moor as bait
Holmes shoots the phosphorescent hound in the fog
Stapleton flees into Grimpen Mire and is presumed drowned
Beryl freed; Holmes explains Stapleton was Rodger Baskerville II
